description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'ChargeDueAtDisbursementCannotBePenaltyException' that extends 'AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException'. It is used to signal an invalid operation where a penalty charge is attempted to be created with a due-at disbursement property, which is disallowed.

classes.name: ChargeDueAtDisbursementCannotBePenaltyException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a penalty charge cannot be set to be due at disbursement.

methods.name: ChargeDueAtDisbursementCannotBePenaltyException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error code and message, incorporating the charge name.
